SUNKEN FATE LIVES ON
it wasn't me it was the one armed man
I just spent 4 minutes staring at my fridge expecting new food to magically spawn in it. How’s your day going?
Bought vegetables with the best of intentions, but we both know they’re just going to turn into green liquid in the crisp drawer while I order takeout.
My brain at 3 PM: fully exhausted, could sleep anywhere. My brain at 11:30 PM: let's rewatch every embarrassing moment from 2018.
I’m not running late, I’m just giving everyone else a head start to keep things fair.
Nothing makes you feel like an absolute child quite like having to make your own doctor's appointment.
We need to hang out soon so we can sit on the same couch in total silence while both scrolling on our phones.
I just typed my password wrong three times in a row with pure confidence.
My phone just alerted me to my screen time and frankly I don't appreciate the personal attack.
I woke up feeling refreshed and ready to conquer the day... and then I opened my eyes.
I’m at that age where if I sleep weird, my neck holds a grudge for three business days.
Currently standing in a room and absolutely forgetting why I walked in here.
I just blew on my ice cream because it was too cold. I think my brain needs a reboot.
My favorite workout is a cross between a lunge and a crunch. I call it lunch.
I’m not lazy, I’m just on energy-saving mode.
That awkward silence when you finish a movie and just stare at the black screen looking at your own reflection.
I have 47 tabs open in my browser right now and I refuse to close a single one of them.
Just accidentally liked a photo from 2014 while deep diving. Time to fake my own death and start over in Alaska.
Me: I need to save money. Also me: Ooh, free shipping if I spend $75 more dollars!
I put on real pants today instead of sweatpants. Please applaud my sacrifice.
Why does autocorrect always assume I’m trying to type ducking?
I’m not saying I’m dramatic, but missing my alarm by 5 minutes felt like a major tragedy.
My alarm went off and I laid there for 10 minutes calculating how much sleep I'd get if I just skipped my entire life.
I just waved back at someone who wasn't waving at me, so now I have to leave the country.
My coffee needs a coffee today.
I’ve reached the point in the week where my main emotion is just an aggressive sigh.
I just watched a 15-minute tutorial on how to do something I will literally never do in my entire life.
I don't need a hair tracker, I just need to count how many times I've dropped my phone on my own face today.
I bought a planner to get my life together and now I can't find the planner.
Is it really multitasking if I’m procrastinating four different things at the exact same time?
I just spent 20 minutes looking for my glasses while they were resting on top of my head.
My favorite exercise is running out of patience.
I’m one inconvenience away from moving to the woods and becoming a local myth.
Just drank water instead of soda. I expect my abs to appear by tomorrow morning.
I told myself I’d only watch one episode. Narrator: They did not watch only one episode.
If I say 'on my way', just know that means I'm currently putting my shoes on.
I love when a package arrives and I get to act surprised like I didn't spend $50 ordering it 3 days ago.
My favorite part of the day is when I get back into bed.
I just coughed in public and had to clear my throat 5 times so people knew I wasn't contagious.
I just tried to hit 'undo' in real life after dropping my fork.
I'm pretty sure my pet thinks my full-time job is just sitting on the couch.
I came, I saw, I got anxious, I left.
I don't know what's worse: waking up early or staying up late knowing I have to wake up early.
My social battery just hit 1%. Time to vanish into the shadows.
I walked past a mirror and had to pause because who allowed me to look this unhinged today?
I just sneezed so hard I think I reset my factory settings.
Every time I clean my room I just end up moving the clutter from one flat surface to another.
I’m not argumentive, I’m just explaining why I’m right.
My internal clock doesn't tell time, it just tells me when I should be eating snacks.
